//: Per-model reasoning/thinking adapter. Maps a model to the request-body fields
//1: that enable its deep-thinking mode on its host. Resolution order at call time:
//2: exact 'provider/model' -> logical name -> model family -> '*' default.
//3: 'body' is shallow-merged into the chat-completions request when reasoning is on.
//4: Every host exposes thinking differently, so these are filled in per model as we
//5: confirm the exact param from each provider's docs (editable, zero code changes).
//6: Leave 'body' empty {} to rely on big token budget + the model's default behaviour.
//7: IMPORTANT: the SAME logical model uses DIFFERENT param shapes per host - NVIDIA
//8: NIM uses chat_template_kwargs, OpenRouter uses top-level reasoning:{enabled},
//9: Cloudflare's newer slots use top-level reasoning_effort or chat_template_kwargs.
//10: Multi-host models are keyed by exact 'provider/model' so the wrong shape never
//11: leaks to a host that would 400 it (a 400 blacklists the slot - keep shapes exact).
//12: Capability sweep 2026-06: ctx windows + extra knobs recorded in notes below.

*.note: default: no special param; rely on token budget + native behaviour

glm-5.1.note: NVIDIA NIM only; confirmed. ctx 131k in/out; emits reasoning_content

deepseek-v4-pro.note: NVIDIA NIM only; confirmed. reasoning_effort max|high|none; ctx 1M. 'high' default - 'max' thinks past every timeout we have (captest judge killed at 35min still thinking); override per-request when truly needed

deepseek-r1.note: github R1-0528 reasons natively; no param. 403s on our tier - kept for when the tier rises. CF r1-distill removed (captest: hallucinated a deadlock fix)

phi-4-reasoning.note: reasoning model by design (github models; streams its think trace). GitHub strips/overrides custom system prompts for this model (captest: in_tokens=233, never saw the input) - quirk folds system into the user message

nvidia/moonshotai/kimi-k2.6.note: NVIDIA NIM Kimi thinking (confirmed). ctx 256k; vision-capable (MoonViT)

cloudflare/@cf/moonshotai/kimi-k2.6.note: CF schema exposes reasoning_effort (no chat_template_kwargs); ctx 262k; tools. CF deprecates max_tokens -> send max_completion_tokens or thinking gets cut mid-trace (seen live)

kimi-k2.6.note: fallback for unlisted hosts: no thinking param

nvidia/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b.note: confirmed. ctx up to 1M. extra knobs: chat_template_kwargs.medium_effort (cheaper traces), force_nonempty_content:true REQUIRED when combining tools+thinking; reasoning_budget is soft (closes at newline before budget or +500 tok)

cloudflare/@cf/nvidia/nemotron-3-120b-a1.note: CF schema exposes chat_template_kwargs + reasoning_effort; ctx 256k; tools. max_completion_tokens (max_tokens deprecated on CF)

nvidia/google/gemma-4-31b-it.note: confirmed. ctx 256k; vision (image+video). rec sampling: temp 1.0 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 64

cloudflare/@cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it.note: CF schema exposes chat_template_kwargs + reasoning_effort; ctx 256k; vision. max_completion_tokens (max_tokens deprecated on CF)

gpt-oss-120b.note: CF chat-completions schema does NOT list reasoning_effort (responses API only) - a rejected param would 400-blacklist the slot, so effort stays default. raise via system prompt 'Reasoning: high' if needed. ctx 128k

step-flash.note: no thinking param documented; ctx 256k; vision; 100-350 tok/s
